description: This Java class defines an immutable implementation of the SizeOption interface, representing a size configuration with a maximum size constraint, including methods for creation, comparison, and string representation.

classes.name: ImmutableSizeOption
classes.description: An immutable class implementing SizeOption, encapsulating a size value with a maximum size constraint and standard methods such as equals, hashCode, and toString.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method for creating an instance of ImmutableSizeOption with a specified size.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a visitor to perform operations on the size option.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another object based on the size value.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns hash code based on size.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns string representation of the size option.
